ns2:section.sectionText: Economic analysis of auctions. Topics include: an introduction to standard auction formats, the independent private values auction model and revenue equivalence, common value auctions and the winner's curse. Applications include eBay and spectrum auctions. The prerequisite Econ 302 will be enforced for this course. If you do not have Econ 302 completed before this course begins, you will be dropped. This section is reserved for graduate MSPE students until after August 18th, 2014 at 9:30am.
